subject: general
question: What did the Supreme Court direct regarding the investigation of 171 alleged fake encounters in Assam?

options.text: Ordered the Assam Human Rights Commission to investigate
Ordered the Assam Human Rights Commission to transferred the cases to the CBI

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ordered the Assam Human Rights Commission to investigate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Supreme Court directed the Assam Human Rights Commission to investigate 171 alleged fake encounters in Assam.
 
• These cases involved allegations against security forces for extrajudicial killings during counter-insurgency operations in the state.
 
• The directive aimed to ensure transparency and accountability in handling the alleged fake encounters.
 
• The investigation was ordered to be conducted impartially and in accordance with legal procedures to uphold human rights.
 
• Such directives from the Supreme Court emphasize the judiciary's role in safeguarding constitutional rights and maintaining checks on government actions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fake Encounters:**

 
 
• Refers to extrajudicial killings where law enforcement agencies claim to have killed suspects in self-defense.
 
• Such incidents are often criticized for bypassing due legal process and violating human rights.
 
 
 
• **Assam Human Rights Commission:**
 
 
• A statutory body established under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.
 
• It is tasked with investigating human rights violations and recommending corrective measures.
 
 
 
• **Supreme Court of India:**
 
 
• The apex judicial authority in India, responsible for safeguarding constitutional rights and ensuring justice.
 
• It holds the power to intervene in cases where constitutional principles and human rights are compromised.
 
 
 
• **Human Rights:**
 
 
• Refer to the basic rights and freedoms that belong to every individual, irrespective of race, religion, or nationality.
 
• Protection of human rights is a fundamental aspect of democratic governance.
